identitySignals: Name matches a California LLC registry listing: 'School Time Music LLC', entity 200813110051, active, mailing address P.O. Box 8636, Emeryville, CA 94662 (bizprofile.net), matching the agenda's Emeryville, CA location
Alphabet Rockers' own website names 'School Time Music LLC' as the entity behind the group; the California Arts Council lists 'Alphabet Rockers (School Time Music LLC)' in Oakland
Website describes music and educational content for children and families, consistent with OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' contracts from the Academics and Instruction Department
research.notes: Registry details come from a third-party mirror of California Secretary of State data (bizprofile.net); the official bizfile site could not be queried. The email is the general customer-service address on the contact page. The company operates as a fiscally sponsored project of Sozo Impact, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, but School Time Music LLC itself is not a nonprofit, so no EIN is given.

profile.summary: School Time Music LLC is a limited liability company based in the Oakland and Emeryville area of California. It operates the family music group Alphabet Rockers, which makes music and educational content about inclusion and belonging for children and families.

sources.title: School Time Music LLC Oakland, CA - filing information

review.notes: The CA registry mirror shows School Time Music LLC (entity 200813110051, Oakland principal address, Emeryville PO Box mailing address matching the agenda), and alphabetrockers.com and the California Arts Council both name School Time Music LLC as the entity behind Alphabet Rockers, whose education and inclusion content fits an Academics and Instruction contract. Legal name, entity number, address, headquarters, the general hq@ email and the website are all supported, and the summary is neutral.
